run_critical_path_analysis: run critical path analysis on a PyTorch profiling trace to find the longest dependency chain
overlay_critical_path_on_trace: overlay critical path analysis results onto a trace file to highlight critical events and edges
test_CPGraph_nodes_and_edges: test the CPGraph node structure and edge weights for a given trace event index
save_and_restore_CPGraph: save a CPGraph to disk and restore it later to recompute the critical path
get_critical_path_breakdown: get a DataFrame breakdown of all critical path edges with their attribution and timing
